title: Desk2Quant: Can you hedge with it?
logline: You can derive Black–Scholes, but can you hedge with it? One notebook drops the hedging error from 2.32 to 0.07, then Desk2Quant is introduced as the place that trains the desk side; comment FREE for all 10 free resources.
